Messages.Author: Dani
Messages.Body:
In the final there was a V5 toreador, a Bannu and 2 Gangrel blockers, who sat down and boxed up the blood brother budapest circle bleeder.

Gangrel Barons=> Bannu => Toreador =>Gangrel Primogen=>Blood Brother.

The first ranked Gangrel Baron moved in front of the bleeder relying on his blocks and redirects, his tarjet: that the blood brother did not gain VP, with a tie he won. The Bannu waited for the moment when the Toreador wore itself out, crashing again and again against the primogen Gangrel that specialized against bleed and politics placed itself in front of the Toreador. The primogen Gangrel attacked the Blood Brother to no avail while fending off the Toreador. And the Blood Brother cautiously bled from the Gangrel Baron's redirects and in turn had all his indirect actions blocked by his prey and predator.

In the end, the bannu's opportunity presented itself when the Toreador found themselves in the clutches of the Gangrel.
